title: Latency Fusionboard: sampling-corrected p50/p95/p99 with trace links and error signatures
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current latency dashboards show percentiles per endpoint/model but are biased by sampling and don't surface the root-cause signals (trace links, error signatures) needed to quickly diagnose regressions. Streaming vs non-streaming decompositions exist in panels across several boards but are inconsistent and lack unified drilldown to traces and associated error signatures in logs.

Goal: Build a single "Fusionboard" that presents sampling-corrected p50/p95/p99 latency for model+route pairs, with side-by-side streaming vs non-streaming decomposition, density heatmap of request shapes (prompt token length / expected output tokens), and direct trace links plus an aggregated "error signature" list derived from logs/stack traces. The board should be useful for on-call and SRE when investigating latency or error spikes and for product/eng postmortems.

Scope:
- Add and document telemetry metrics (Prometheus + long-term store) for sampling-corrected histograms and io_mode label (streaming|nonstreaming).
- Enrich trace hooks so trace IDs are emitted in 100% of sampled slow requests and surface trace links in dashboard panels.
- Create a new Grafana dashboard (Fusionboard) with: p50/p95/p99 timelines, streaming vs non-streaming stacked breakdown, request-shape heatmap, error-signature list (Top 10 grouped by fingerprint), and quick links to trace viewer and GitHub PRs for recent deploys.
- Implement alerting rules for sudden divergence between streaming and non-streaming p95 (>25% delta sustained 5m) and for top-error-signature spike.

Non-goals: End-to-end sampling rate increase for all requests (we will correct metrics for existing sampling), full APM rework, or replacing existing specialized latency boards.

Telemetry changes (high-level):
- Metric names added: request_latency_seconds_bucket_corrected{model,route,io_mode,le}, request_latency_samples{model,route,io_mode}, request_error_count{model,route,error_fingerprint}.
- Tracing: ensure trace_id is attached to logs for sampled slow requests and add a small trace hook in serving runtime to emit trace metadata when latency > p95 by model-route window.
- Logs: add error_fingerprint extraction stage in the log pipeline (pattern + stack fingerprinting) and forward counts to long-term store (ClickHouse) for aggregation.

Design notes:
- Use histogram-correction approach: capture sample_rate and use count-weighted histograms to approximate true percentiles. We'll persist correction metadata as metric labels where feasible.
- io_mode label comes from request metadata (streaming, nonstreaming, batch). Use consistent naming across runtime and SDKs.
- For request-shape heatmap, derive two dimensions: input_token_count and max_generation_tokens. Buckets will be small (<64, 64-256, 256-1024, >1024).

Acceptance criteria (must be verifiable):
- Dashboard exists at /dashboards/Fusionboard-latency-fusion and is linked from Console Observability home. (manual)
- Prometheus (or long-term store) contains request_latency_seconds_bucket_corrected with io_mode label for at least 90% of model-route pairs. (query)
- Dashboard panels provide clickable trace links that open the trace viewer at the correct trace_id for sampled records. (manual)
- Alert rule firing test: simulated increase in streaming p95 (via replay) triggers the streaming/nonstreaming divergence alert. (test run)
- Error-signature aggregation shows top 10 fingerprints for the last 6 hours and links to example logs. (manual/query)

Implementation plan (high level tasks):
- T1: Telemetry schema proposal and PR (prometheus metric names + labels) — owner: @liam-oconnor.
- T2: Runtime trace hook change: emit trace metadata when request latency exceeds adaptive threshold (p95) and attach trace_id to logs — owner: runtime team.
- T3: Log pipeline enrichment: add fingerprint extraction transform and export to ClickHouse & metrics exporter — owner: infra-logging.
- T4: Dashboard implementation & queries (Grafana panels + PromQL / ClickHouse SQL) — owner: observability-ux.
- T5: Alerts & Runbook updates — owner: SRE.

Queries (examples):
- PromQL 95th (sampling-corrected): histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket_corrected[5m])) by (le, model, route, io_mode))
- Streaming vs nonstreaming delta: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(...) by (le, model, route, io_mode{io_mode="streaming"}))) / histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(...) by (le, model, route, io_mode{io_mode="nonstreaming"})))) - 1
- Error signature topN (ClickHouse): SELECT error_fingerprint, count() AS cnt FROM logs WHERE timestamp >= now()-INTERVAL 6 HOUR GROUP BY error_fingerprint ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

Risks and mitigation:
- Correcting percentiles for sampling can still be skewed for very low-traffic model-route pairs: show sample_rate badge on dashboard and hide corrected percentiles when sample_rate < 0.01.
- Additional overhead for trace hook emissions: make trace hook conditional and rate-limited; default only emit for requests above p95 over last 1h window.
- Fingerprinting false positives: tune fingerprint rules and allow manual suppression per-service.

Rollout plan:
- Stage 1 (canary): enable for 5 busiest model-route combos for a week, collect feedback.
- Stage 2: expand to top 50 routes, enable dashboard panels in read-only mode.
- Stage 3: full rollout once stability and metric accuracy validated.
